map.质量（标准/检测/保障）体系 使用指南: Quality (Standards / Testing / Assurance) System User Guide
map.输入婚礼策划、场地、司仪、摄影等各环节的质量评分，按权重综合评估整体服务质量等级: Enter quality scores for wedding planning, venue, MC, photography and other stages; the tool weights them into an overall service quality grade and customer satisfaction score, for wedding service acceptance and improvement.
map.在wedding场景里，先统一 Detector 33 的输入口径，再输出可复用: In a wedding scenario, first unify the input conventions of Detector 33, then output a reusable structure for fast reconciliation and review.
map.当同类任务需要批量处理时，可用该工具做第一轮标准化；结果异常时再回到人工复核环节: When similar tasks need batch processing, use this tool for a first standardization pass; when results look anomalous, return to manual review to reduce misses.
map.在业务流程中，先做小样本试算再扩展规模，能快速验证参数假设是否与实际口径一致。: In a business process, run a small-sample trial before scaling up to quickly verify whether parameter assumptions match actual conventions.
map.：先准备一组典型样本并固定单位与格式，运行一次并记录输出；再切换到边界样本（含缺: : first prepare a typical sample set and fix units and formats, run once and record the output; then switch to boundary samples (missing entries, outliers) and check whether explainable results appear, so that a reproducible analysis checklist takes shape.
map.这个 wedding 工具适合什么阶段使用？: What stage is this wedding tool suited to?
map.适合需求澄清和第一轮评估阶段；输出可直接用于方案讨论、初筛与结果复核，但关键决策: Suited to requirements clarification and first-round assessment; the output can feed directly into scheme discussion, screening and result review, but key decisions should be confirmed against historical strategy.
map.如何减少误用导致的偏差？: How to reduce bias from misuse?
map.建议固定输入单位、统一日期范围，并与对照样本比对；如出现明显偏移，优先核查原始数: Fix input units, unify date ranges and compare against a control sample; if obvious offsets appear, check the raw-data cleaning rules first.
